statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit across six representative paths. The required age gate was treated as applicable site content; media playback and explicit-content interaction were intentionally not needed to assess the templates.

page.framework: Vue present among several page scripts; primarily server-rendered MPA
page.notes: Adult media catalog with mandatory age verification, consent UI, browse/search/category listings, detail pages and account entry.

artifacts.caption: Mobile entry showing clipped age gate
Heap summary after repeated combobox interaction

checkOutcomes.method: Computed-style and stylesheet-signal probe under prefers-color-scheme: dark
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is dark in both default and emulated-dark conditions, while runtime HTML/CSS signals contain no prefers-color-scheme or color-scheme support; the fixed palette does not respond to the user preference.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() returned zero active animations on the entry state.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit plus screenshot review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no color-contrast audit failures and the dark entry screen retained high-contrast white/orange controls.
The runtime/source signal probe found no view-transition usage, so route and state changes use abrupt swaps.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS signal probe plus layout and trace long-task observers
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animations or scroll-timeline signals were present, and layout/trace observers recorded no long tasks; the page does not implement scroll effects with blocking handlers in the observed state.
The representative pages use native document scrolling and ordinary links/buttons; no pointer-driven gesture surface or custom gesture requirement appeared in the DOM recon.
The long feed exposes static navigation and no scroll-state/container-query or progress-indicator signal.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM overlay inventory and representative screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, contextual popover, or viewport-edge anchored menu was present on the inspected entry/listing/detail states, so no drifting manually positioned overlay was observed.
The age gate presents a single prominent heading and paired enter/exit actions, while navigation and media links use descriptive visible labels.

checkOutcomes.method: Initial-load screenshot and DOM text review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The initial full-screen age gate is required for this adult site and provides immediate Enter, Exit, parental-control and terms choices; cookie consent also offers essential-only and customization controls.
The age and consent overlays are custom DIV structures with ARIA roles; the DOM contains zero dialog, popover, and details elements.
The required age gate is visually restrained and content-focused, with no decorative imagery competing with its decision text.
At 360px the entry modal is visibly clipped on the right: its heading, legal text, and Exit action extend beyond the captured viewport even though overflow is suppressed.
The rendered source signal probe found no @container/container-type use across reused feed and overlay components.
Programmatic focus did not move to the Enter button and its computed outline was none; the mobile probe also counted 85 rendered targets below 24px in one dimension.
The entry page states that it is an adult site and makes Enter and Exit the dominant paired actions.
Direct browse, categories, search-results and detail URLs returned populated server-rendered content, providing a continuous find-and-open-content path without requiring playback for verification.
The constrained entry state provides explicit Exit, parental-control guidance, terms and consent choices, preserving a safe recovery path.
Lighthouse measured LCP 4541ms and CLS 0.824; both exceed the good Core Web Vitals thresholds.
Lighthouse measured CLS 0.824 and the mobile layout observer independently recorded a 0.102 shift around 1.86s.
The trace measured zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 32.5ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM/source capture
checkOutcomes.evidence: The HAR recorded 173 requests and 5.23MB transferred, including seven parser-inserted very-high-priority stylesheets and multiple parser-inserted scripts requiring blocking review.
Lighthouse estimated 294,838 bytes of unused JavaScript and 75,725 bytes of unused CSS; 40 scripts were requested.
Lighthouse reported zero image-alt and label failures; all 37 inspected images had alt text, and the search field has aria-label="Search".
Lighthouse reported zero contrast failures on the tested page.
The homepage has no H1, overlays use custom role-bearing DIVs, and focusing the primary Enter button did not produce active focus or a visible outline.
At 360px the age-gate heading, paragraphs, links and second action are clipped off-screen, preventing comfortable reading.
The mobile probe counted 85 rendered controls/links below 24px in one dimension, and the representative detail page exposes two video elements but no caption tracks.
Lighthouse recorded one console-error item during load.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse document audit and image inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Although doctype/charset are present, the image audit found 3 images without dimensions and 20 legacy-format images.
Lighthouse reported two deprecated-API warnings and DevTools inspector issues.
Homepage and detail both expose the generic title “Pornhub” and no meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Anchor inventory plus raw HTTP robots request
checkOutcomes.evidence: 18 of 124 homepage anchors use javascript: URLs, and /robots.txt redirects to the homepage instead of serving robot directives.

checkOutcomes.method: Detail metadata, robots and sitemap probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The detail response declares noindex,nofollow and canonicalizes to the homepage; hreflang is absent and /sitemap.xml returns 404.
The representative detail page has no JSON-LD and no Open Graph tags despite representing a video entity.
HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and X-Content-Type-Options are missing; cookie audit also found an rp cookie without Secure and all seven cookies using SameSite=None.
The load contacted 12 third-party origins, including Google Tag Manager and DoubleClick; 102 requests and 2.29MB were third-party.
No permission prompt fired on load, but the site exposes sign-in while the inspected runtime contained no WebAuthn/passkey signal and the account route redirected to the homepage.
HSTS and SAMEORIGIN framing are configured, but CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent from the main response.
Raw HTML is substantial rather than an empty JS shell; the detail H1 survives without JavaScript and crawler coverage was 37%.
The age-verification overlay is clipped at 360px, including its legal copy and Exit action, so this critical runtime layer does not remain robust at a common viewport.
This streaming/search service is intrinsically online; an offline media experience is not a reasonable requirement for the audited public paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: This streaming/search service is intrinsically online; an offline media experience is not a reasonable requirement for the audited public paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The sitemap/unknown-resource test returned a bare “404 Not Found openresty” page with no site navigation, explanation, or recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language, visible-text and metadata review
checkOutcomes.evidence: html lang="es" is correct, but visible Spanish pages contain substantial untranslated English UI/content and expose no hreflang alternate links.
No dates, currencies, durations-as-locale-data, or other locale-formatted values were part of the representative task surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: No dates, currencies, durations-as-locale-data, or other locale-formatted values were part of the representative task surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive flow appeared on the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive flow appeared on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The observed consent layer offers Accept All, Accept Only Essential and Customize choices, while the age gate provides equally visible Enter and Exit actions.
The inspected primary search path has no required input or validation error state, and the account form was not served at its direct route.
checkOutcomes.reason: The inspected primary search path has no required input or validation error state, and the account form was not served at its direct route.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The only available user input was a clearly named search control; no address, payment, sign-in or sign-up field requiring autocomplete assistance was served.
Direct navigation to the account-creation route silently redirected to the homepage, leaving no clear sign-up state, explanation, or recovery path.
Of 37 images, 33 lacked srcset and 20 used legacy formats; three omitted dimensions.
The initial load made 173 requests, including 38 XHR/fetches and duplicated analytics delivery, before a content choice was made.
Third parties accounted for 102 requests and 2.29MB, with ad-network imagery and three Google Tag Manager scripts among the largest costs.
Agent-facing capabilities are emerging and not declared as an intent for this public adult-media catalog; absence of WebMCP is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.
checkOutcomes.reason: Agent-facing capabilities are emerging and not declared as an intent for this public adult-media catalog; absence of WebMCP is treated as an opportunity, not a failure.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task in the representative public paths requires on-device inference, and agent readiness is contextual/emerging.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the representative public paths requires on-device inference, and agent readiness is contextual/emerging.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten open/close attempts on the language combobox, heap self size increased by 752,176 bytes (2.0%) and closures by 98 (0.2%), with no unbounded retained-growth signal in this bounded sample.
The loaded media feed used 37.99MB heap self size and 1,425 live DOM elements, a bounded footprint for the observed content-rich page.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor comparison and runtime listener probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appeared among either heap summary’s largest constructors; closures changed only from 52,191 to 52,289 and instrumentable inline listeners were bounded at eight.

paths.description: Homepage, age-verification and consent entry state; represents global navigation and the main feed.
Video listing template; represents browse/navigation and repeated media cards.
Category index template; represents taxonomy navigation.
Representative video detail page, inspected without starting playback; represents media metadata and controls.
Search-results template for the query “podcast”; represents the primary find-content journey.
Direct account-creation route; represents sign-up/account entry.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Dark emulation remains usable but source/runtime probes contain no color-scheme preference support.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: No view-transition signal was found across the rendered source.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions to meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The long feed has no scroll-state-aware navigation cue.
findings.evidence: No scroll-state query or progress affordance was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a shrinking sticky header or lightweight progress/scrollability affordance driven by scroll-state where useful.

findings.summary: Critical overlays use custom DIVs instead of semantic dialog primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM inventory found custom role=alertdialog/dialog structures and zero dialog/popover/details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the age/consent modal and declarative controls/light dismiss where policy permits.

findings.summary: The age gate is clipped at 360px.
findings.evidence: Mobile screenshot cuts off heading, legal copy and the Exit action despite no reported scroll overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the modal inline-size: min(100% - spacing, max width), remove fixed minimum widths, allow wrapping, and verify reflow at 320–400px.

findings.summary: Reusable components expose no container-query adaptation.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS/HTML signals contain no @container or container-type usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply container-type and size-aware component styles where cards/overlays are reused at different widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and target sizing are unreliable.
findings.evidence: Primary-button focus did not become active or visible; 85 rendered targets were below 24px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore native focusability, add a strong :focus-visible ring, and enlarge compact links/buttons to accessible target sizes.

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals are outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.54s and CLS 0.824.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element, reserve layout space, and defer non-critical scripts/styles; verify LCP <=2.5s and CLS <=0.1.

findings.summary: Late content causes severe visual instability.
findings.evidence: CLS was 0.824 in Lighthouse and 0.102 in the mobile layout observer.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for banners/images and stabilize font/ad slots before paint.

findings.summary: The critical network path is large and render-blocking.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 173 requests, 5.23MB, seven high-priority parser stylesheets and parser scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, and set intentional preload priorities.

findings.summary: Substantial unused JavaScript and CSS ship on first load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 294,838 unused JS bytes and 75,725 unused CSS bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route features and conditionally load ads/analytics and page-specific styles.

findings.summary: Heading semantics and keyboard focus are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Homepage has no H1 and the primary Enter control showed no active/visible programmatic focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1, use semantic landmarks/dialog, and preserve a logical visible focus order.

findings.summary: Legal and action text does not reflow on mobile.
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot clips multiple lines and controls off the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed-width modal internals and test text wrapping/zoom at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Small targets and missing video caption tracks reduce access.
findings.evidence: 85 rendered controls/links are below 24px in one dimension; the detail page has two videos and zero tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target sizes and provide synchronized captions/subtitles or an equivalent transcript for media.

findings.summary: The page logs a console error during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse console audit reported one item.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the recorded runtime/network exception and keep production loads console-clean.

findings.summary: Image delivery has avoidable structural and format issues.
findings.evidence: Three images lack dimensions and 20 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and serve modern responsive sources.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and inspector issues remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two deprecation warnings and logged DevTools Issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs and clear all production DevTools Issues.

findings.summary: Page titles are generic and descriptions are absent.
findings.evidence: Homepage and detail both report “Pornhub” and no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique descriptive titles and meta descriptions per template/entity.

findings.summary: Crawler navigation and robots delivery are broken.
findings.evidence: 18 anchors use javascript: and /robots.txt redirects to the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation and serve a valid robots.txt with an explicit policy.

findings.summary: Indexing signals conflict on detail pages.
findings.evidence: Detail is noindex,nofollow, canonicals to home, has no hreflang, and sitemap.xml is 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose an intentional indexing policy; for public pages use self-canonicals, aligned robots/sitemap, and locale alternates.

findings.summary: Video pages lack structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD or Open Graph tags were found on the representative detail page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Transport hardening and cookie attributes are incomplete.
findings.evidence: CSP and nosniff are missing; rp lacks Secure and all seven cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP and nosniff; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site behavior is required.

findings.summary: The pre-consent third-party footprint is large.
findings.evidence: 12 third-party origins, 102 requests and 2.29MB include GTM and DoubleClick.
findings.suggestedFix: Default to essential-only, gate optional tags on consent, minimize events and batch approved analytics.

findings.summary: No phishing-resistant authentication signal was found.
findings.evidence: Sign-in exists, but runtime/account probes found no WebAuthn/passkey surface and account navigation redirected home.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn in sign-in and account management while keeping prompts in context.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing, and no CSP frame-ancestors policy is served.
findings.suggestedFix: Add least-privilege Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and express framing in CSP.

findings.summary: The critical overlay is not resilient at narrow widths.
findings.evidence: The required age-verification layer clips its content and second action at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Rebuild the overlay with intrinsic sizing, semantic dialog behavior, and viewport-edge-safe reflow.

findings.summary: HTTP failure state is a dead end.
findings.evidence: The tested 404 response is only “404 Not Found openresty” with no recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded lightweight 404 with explanation, search/home links and preserved language.

findings.summary: Localization signals and translation completeness are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: lang=es is present, but visible strings remain English and no hreflang alternates exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Finish Spanish localization, use logical properties, and publish hreflang links for supported locales.

findings.summary: The account creation journey silently redirects to home.
findings.evidence: The direct create-account URL finishes at the homepage without an account form or explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve a clear account route, state prerequisites, and provide an actionable recovery path.

findings.summary: Most images are not responsive or modern-format.
findings.evidence: 33/37 images lack srcset and 20 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants with srcset/sizes and retained intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: The entry load performs excessive background/network work.
findings.evidence: 173 requests include 38 XHR/fetches before the user enters.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer optional fetching until intent/consent and batch low-priority telemetry.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and ad media dominate the resource budget.
findings.evidence: Third parties consume 102 requests and 2.29MB, including large ad images and GTM bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove low-value vendors, defer ad media and cache proportionately.

taskList.title: Fix age-gate reflow, semantics, focus and target sizes
Stabilize layout and reduce LCP-critical network work
Repair titles, descriptions, canonical/robots/sitemap and video metadata
Harden CSP, cookies and browser policies
Restore account flow and add passkey support
Clear console, deprecation and DevTools issues
Finish Spanish localization and locale metadata
Add preference-driven theming and restrained transitions/navigation cues
